title: Q4 Roadmap Planning
decisions: Offline mode is the top Q4 priority for the mobile app
Semantic search moves to Q1 next year

action_items.task: Write the offline mode technical design doc
Estimate backend sync API changes for offline mode

transcript:
Ava Chen: Let's lock the Q4 roadmap today. We have three candidates: offline mode, semantic search and the new onboarding flow.
Marcus Bell: Offline mode is the most requested feature in support tickets. About a third of churned users mention unreliable connectivity.
Priya Nair: Offline mode is also the riskiest. We need conflict resolution for edits made on two devices, and the sync API was never designed for that.
Diego Alvarez: From the design side, onboarding is mostly done. We could ship it with one engineer in the background.
Ava Chen: Then offline mode is the top Q4 priority. Semantic search slides to Q1 next year. Any objections?
Marcus Bell: None, but I need a week to estimate the backend sync changes before we commit to dates.
Priya Nair: I'll write the technical design doc for offline mode, covering local storage, the sync protocol and conflict resolution.
Ava Chen: Good. I'll open two backend requisitions, because sync work will stretch the team.
Diego Alvarez: I'll keep onboarding moving and share final mocks next week.
